label: 🗺 Export to map
description: Render geographical points on an interactive world map. Pick one column with the location (lat,lon string, separate lat/lon columns, or WKT POINT). Optional name + comment columns control the hover tooltip.

format.label: Location format
format.help: How the location column encodes coordinates. 'lat_lon' = '37.77,-122.42' (Google / Apple style), 'lon_lat' = '-122.42,37.77' (GeoJSON / WKT axis order), 'wkt_point' = 'POINT(-122.42 37.77)', 'separate_columns' = pick a lat column and a lon column separately.

location.label: Location column
location.help: The column with the geographical coordinates. Required unless format = 'separate_columns' (then leave blank and pick lat_col + lon_col instead).

name_col.label: Name column (optional)
name_col.help: Column used as the bold tooltip headline. If blank, the row index is used.

comment_col.label: Comment column (optional)
comment_col.help: Column rendered underneath the headline. Free-form text.

marker_color.label: Marker color
marker_color.help: Any valid CSS color — hex, rgb(), or named. Default emerald (#10b981) matches the DIG palette.

tile_provider.label: Map tiles
tile_provider.help: Tile basemap. Carto Light is the cleanest for data overlays; OSM has the most labels; Esri NatGeo is the prettiest but heaviest.

max_points.label: Max points to plot
max_points.help: If the input has more rows than this, the step samples down. Browsers struggle past ~50K markers.

format_out.label: Output format
format_out.help: 'html' produces an interactive Leaflet map (hover tooltips, zoom, pan). 'png' produces a static rasterised view — useful for headless CI.
